schema_note: Canonical public URLs for agents and buyers. Regenerate: npm run docs:sync-endpoints (reads repo-root .env). Commit result for GitHub Pages. Stable HTTPS + mainnet alignment: documentation/PUBLIC_MAINNET_OPERATIONS.md

endpoints.label: T54 XRPL x402 seller (discovery origin)
endpoints.description: Discovery appends each SKU path from x402_providers.json. With unified Caddy, base URL ends with /t54.

endpoints.label: T54 XRPL well-known catalog
endpoints.description: Machine-readable XRPL SKU catalog for agent discovery (paths, drops, payTo, facilitator).

endpoints.label: T54 XRPL agent card
endpoints.description: Agent capability card listing T54/LCG XRPL skills and endpoints.

endpoints.label: T54 XRPL — LCG Procurement Readiness Scan
endpoints.description: Entry SKU for LCG procurement intelligence on XRPL (POST JSON; GET ?payload= also supported).

endpoints.label: T54 XRPL — agent pre-flight check
endpoints.description: GET /t54/x402/v1/preflight — same asm.preflight.v1 engine as the Base headline SKU, settled in XRP via T54 (4000 drops). Invalid input returns a free 400.

endpoints.label: Base USDC — agent pre-flight check (headline)
endpoints.description: GET /x402/v1/preflight?contractAddress=0x… and/or payTo=0x…|r… (required), optional resource. Invalid input returns a free 400. First 5 calls per caller per UTC day are free; then $0.01 USDC. Verdicts: SAFE, RISKY, or INCONCLUSIVE (lookup failures are never RISKY). Example: contractAddress=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913.

endpoints.label: Base USDC x402 seller (facilitator / Bazaar)
endpoints.description: GET /x402/v1/query — constitution-safe structured Q&A with source attribution. Listed on CDP Bazaar.

endpoints.label: Base USDC — constitution audit
endpoints.description: GET /x402/v1/constitution-audit — heuristic ethics and constitution-style review of a prompt excerpt.

endpoints.label: Base USDC — agent commerce data
endpoints.description: GET /x402/v1/agent-commerce-data — premium x402 commerce intelligence bundle.

endpoints.label: Base USDC — commerce supplier trust
endpoints.description: GET /x402/v1/commerce/supplier-trust — supplier trust pack for agent commerce.

endpoints.label: Base USDC — commerce product evidence
endpoints.description: GET /x402/v1/commerce/product-evidence — product evidence pack for agent commerce.

endpoints.label: Base USDC — commerce product search
endpoints.description: GET /x402/v1/commerce/product-search — product search pack for agent commerce.

endpoints.label: Base USDC — airdrop intelligence
endpoints.description: GET /x402/v1/airdrop-intelligence — airdrop scam screening with Farm Score and EIP-7702 detection.

endpoints.label: Base USDC — Celo agent data
endpoints.description: GET /x402/v1/celo-agent-data — Celo-rail evidence packed for buyers, settled in Base USDC.

endpoints.label: Base USDC — research brief
endpoints.description: GET /x402/v1/research-brief — short research brief for agent buyers.

endpoints.label: Base USDC intake resale (same packs as T54 XRPL)
endpoints.description: GET /x402/v1/intake-resale?pack_id=<id> (required). Missing/unknown pack_id returns a free 400. Public demo: ?pack_id=demo.

endpoints.label: Base USDC — ecosystem pulse
endpoints.description: GET /x402/v1/ecosystem-pulse — PoCon ecosystem pulse: oracle snapshot, worker activity, bazaar readiness.

endpoints.label: Base USDC — contract triage
endpoints.description: GET /x402/v1/contract-triage?contractAddress=0x… (required, alias: address). Missing/invalid address returns a free 400. Example: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913.

endpoints.label: Celo USDC x402 query
endpoints.description: GET /celo/x402/v1/query — constitution-safe Q&A settled in Celo USDC (eip155:42220). Not the native fulfillQuery rail.

endpoints.label: Celo native x402 seller (api_402 / fulfillQuery)
endpoints.description: GET/POST /celo/query — HTTP 402 with 0.001 CELO via AgentRevenueService.fulfillQuery (no facilitator).

endpoints.label: Marketplace HTTP (Stripe MPP, buyer API, webhooks)
endpoints.description: Stripe MPP + buyer API + webhooks: unified Caddy maps /webhooks/stripe, /v1/*, /marketplace/* to marketplace:serve (8055). Same public HTTPS origin as x402/T54 when MARKETPLACE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL is that origin.

endpoints.label: MCP T54 x402 (SSE, remote clients)
endpoints.description: Streamable HTTP (Smithery): POST .../mcp (port 9052, mcp>=1.23). SSE: GET .../mcp/sse, POST .../mcp/messages/ (9051). Caddy: exact /mcp → 9052; /mcp/* → 9051. Set MCP_SSE_PUBLIC_URL to your public HTTPS origin + /mcp.
